import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/data/scripts')
import spotter_settings as st

# Read and write path for the runtime-tunable workflow settings behind the
# Configuration panel. One webhook serves both so there is a single route, a
# single active flag and a single deploy to keep in sync -- `action` selects.
#
# Reads are open to any authenticated operator: seeing that the bucket probe is
# capped at 150 is not sensitive, and the panel has to render for everyone.
# WRITES are admin-only. These values are global -- one operator widening the
# active probe changes every other operator's scans -- so the write is gated on
# X-Spotter-Admin, which nginx stamps from the auth subrequest and which
# proxy_set_header always overwrites. A forged header cannot survive the gate.
# Fails closed: anything that is not an explicit admin marker is not an admin.
try:
    user = st.caller(_items)
    if not user:
        return [{'json': {'ok': False, 'error': 'unauthenticated'}}]

    body = st.body_of(_items)
    action = str(body.get('action') or 'get').strip().lower()
    admin = st.is_admin(_items)

    saved = False
    if action == 'save':
        if not admin:
            return [{'json': {'ok': False, 'error': 'admin required',
                              'user': user, 'is_admin': False}}]
        values = body.get('values')
        if not isinstance(values, dict):
            return [{'json': {'ok': False, 'error': 'values must be an object',
                              'user': user, 'is_admin': True}}]
        st.write_settings(values, user)
        saved = True

    # Always answer with the EFFECTIVE state, never with what was submitted:
    # write_settings clamps to each setting's bounds and drops blanks back to
    # the env/default tier, so echoing the request would show the operator a
    # value the workflows will not actually use.
    return [{'json': {'ok': True, 'user': user, 'is_admin': admin,
                      'saved': saved, 'settings': st.effective()}}]
except Exception as e:
    return [{'json': {'ok': False, 'error': str(e)[:400]}}]

meta.notes: POST /webhook/settings {action:'get'} - returns every runtime-tunable workflow setting with its effective value and source (override|env|default). POST {action:'save', values:{NAME:value}} - persists overrides to the single global Neo4j node (:SpotterMeta {key:'settings'}); ADMIN ONLY, gated on the X-Spotter-Admin header stamped by the nginx auth gate. A value of null or '' removes the override and falls back to env/default. All values are clamped to the bounds in scripts/spotter_settings.SETTINGS_SPEC. Backs the Configuration panel in the SPOTTER UI; consumed by WF04, WF11 and WF13.
